entries.title: I Kings 18:1
segments: ¶And it came to pass [after] many days that the word of the LORD came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the earth."

entries.title: I Kings 18:2
segments: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab; and [there was] a severe famine in Samaria.

entries.title: I Kings 18:3
segments: And Ahab had called Obadiah, who [was] in charge of [his] house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly.

entries.title: I Kings 18:4
segments: For so it was, while Jezebel massacred the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah had taken one hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty to a cave, and had fed them with bread and water.)

entries.title: I Kings 18:5
segments: And Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go into the land to all the springs of water and to all the brooks; perhaps we may find grass to keep the horses and mules alive, so that we will not have to kill any livestock.

entries.title: I Kings 18:6
segments: So they divided the land between them to explore it; Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

entries.title: I Kings 18:7
segments: Now as Obadiah was on his way, suddenly Elijah met him; and he recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, "[Is] that you, my lord Elijah?"

entries.title: I Kings 18:8
segments: And he answered him, "[It is] I. Go, tell your master, 'Elijah [is here].'"

entries.title: I Kings 18:9
segments: So he said, "How have I sinned, that you are delivering your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?

entries.title: I Kings 18:10
segments: "[As] the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to hunt for you; and when they said, '[He is] not [here],' he took an oath from the kingdom or nation that they could not find you.

entries.title: I Kings 18:11
segments: "And now you say, 'Go, tell your master, "Elijah [is here]"'!

entries.title: I Kings 18:12
segments: "And it shall come to pass, [as soon as] I am gone from you, that the Spirit of the LORD will carry you to a place I do not know; so when I go and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he will kill me. But I your servant have feared the LORD from my youth.

entries.title: I Kings 18:13
segments: "Was it not reported to my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD, how I hid one hundred men of the LORD'S prophets, fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

entries.title: I Kings 18:14
segments: "And now you say, 'Go, tell your master, "Elijah [is here]."' He will kill me!"

entries.title: I Kings 18:15
segments: Then Elijah said, "[As] the LORD of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely present myself to him today."

entries.title: I Kings 18:16
segments: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

entries.title: I Kings 18:17
segments: ¶Then it happened, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to him, "[Is that] you, O troubler of Israel?"

entries.title: I Kings 18:18
segments: And he answered, "I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father's house [have], in that you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.

entries.title: I Kings 18:19
segments: "Now therefore, send [and] gather all Israel to me on Mount Carmel, the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal, and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel's table."

entries.title: I Kings 18:20
segments: So Ahab sent for all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together on Mount Carmel.

entries.title: I Kings 18:21
segments: ¶And Elijah came to all the people, and said, "How long will you falter between two opinions? If the LORD [is] God, follow Him; but if Baal, follow him." But the people answered him not a word.

entries.title: I Kings 18:22
segments: Then Elijah said to the people, "I alone am left a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets [are] four hundred and fifty men.

entries.title: I Kings 18:23
segments: "Therefore let them give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, cut it in pieces, and lay [it] on the wood, but put no fire [under it]; and I will prepare the other bull, and lay [it] on the wood, but put no fire [under it].

entries.title: I Kings 18:24
segments: "Then you call on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD; and the God who answers by fire, He is God." So all the people answered and said, "It is well spoken."

entries.title: I Kings 18:25
segments: Now Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one bull for yourselves and prepare [it] first, for you [are] many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire [under it]."

entries.title: I Kings 18:26
segments: So they took the bull which was given them, and they prepared [it], and called on the name of Baal from morning even till noon, saying, "O Baal, hear us!" But [there was]  no voice; no one answered. Then they leaped about the altar which they had made.

entries.title: I Kings 18:27
segments: And so it was, at noon, that Elijah mocked them and said, "Cry aloud, for he [is] a god; either he is meditating, or he is busy, or he is on a journey, [or] perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened."

entries.title: I Kings 18:28
segments: So they cried aloud, and cut themselves, as was their custom, with knives and lances, until the blood gushed out on them.

entries.title: I Kings 18:29
segments: And when midday was past, they prophesied until the [time] of the offering of the [evening] sacrifice. But [there was] no voice; no one answered, no one paid attention.

entries.title: I Kings 18:30
segments: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come near to me." So all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD [that was] broken down.

entries.title: I Kings 18:31
segments: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come, saying, "Israel shall be your name."

entries.title: I Kings 18:32
segments: Then with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD; and he made a trench around the altar large enough to hold two seahs of seed.

entries.title: I Kings 18:33
segments: And he put the wood in order, cut the bull in pieces, and laid [it] on the wood, and said, "Fill four waterpots with water, and pour [it] on the burnt sacrifice and on the wood."

entries.title: I Kings 18:34
segments: Then he said, "Do [it] a second time," and they did [it] a second time; and he said, "Do [it] a third time," and they did [it] a third time.

entries.title: I Kings 18:35
segments: So the water ran all around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.

entries.title: I Kings 18:36
segments: And it came to pass, at [the time of] the offering of the [evening] sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near and said, "LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You [are] God in Israel and I [am] Your servant, and [that] I have done all these things at Your word.

entries.title: I Kings 18:37
segments: "Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that You [are] the LORD God, and [that] You have turned their hearts back [to You] again."

entries.title: I Kings 18:38
segments: Then the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood and the stones and the dust, and it licked up the water that [was] in the trench.

entries.title: I Kings 18:39
segments: Now when all the people saw [it], they fell on their faces; and they said, "The LORD, He [is] God! The LORD, He [is] God!"

entries.title: I Kings 18:40
segments: And Elijah said to them, "Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let one of them escape!" So they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the Brook Kishon and executed them there.

entries.title: I Kings 18:41
segments: ¶Then Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink; for [there is] the sound of abundance of rain."

entries.title: I Kings 18:42
segments: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; then he bowed down on the ground, and put his face between his knees,

entries.title: I Kings 18:43
segments: and said to his servant, "Go up now, look toward the sea." So he went up and looked, and said, "[There is] nothing." And seven times he said, "Go again."

entries.title: I Kings 18:44
segments: Then it came to pass the seventh [time], that he said, "There is a cloud, as small as a man's hand, rising out of the sea!" So he said, "Go up, say to Ahab, 'Prepare [your chariot] , and go down before the rain stops you.'"

entries.title: I Kings 18:45
segments: Now it happened in the meantime that the sky became black with clouds and wind, and there was a heavy rain. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.

entries.title: I Kings 18:46
segments: Then the hand of the LORD came upon Elijah; and he girded up his loins and ran ahead of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
